messages:
tom: Quick thread to nail a shipable "minimal" for private deployments focusing on networking handoff + upgrade safety. Looking for consensus on launch gates and owners.

claire: Love it. My headline: keep GA conservative. GA should guarantee an explicit IP continuity story + a documented peering handoff play.

lina: Field voice: customers want two modes: direct peering (BGP/cloud-peering) and hosted-relay. Most prefer peering but only if we can promise no external IP churn during upgrade.

devon: Implementation note: to guarantee IP continuity we should support preserving Service/LoadBalancer external IPs by reusing existing resource annotations where cloud allows. Also outline a secondary mode using NAT relay for envs where peering impossible.

mike: Runtime constraints: leader-election + KV cache warmup must survive control-plane upgrades. Plan: canary CP, wait for KV warm, then roll DP. Automation: operator will expose an upgrade-ready hook.

sara: Support ask: document a peering handoff checklist (who to email, expected maintenance windows, sample BGP filters). Add a 1-page runbook the customer can share with their netops.

priya: Security gating: BYO-KMS patterns, signed installer artifacts, and recommended IAM templates. Also require audit-log routing instructions (SIEM integration) for GA.

tom: For offline/airgapped customers: we need a signed tarball + checksums + an offline install script + a signed manifest indicating version and compatible operator CRDs. Is that feasible?

devon: Yep. We'll produce signed artifacts and a small installer binary that verifies signatures. Add verification steps to the smoke test.

mike: Also include a post-upgrade validation job customers can run that checks: endpoints reachable, IPs unchanged, KV cache warmed, and version parity across nodes. We can supply a kubectl-based script.

lina: Customer acceptance criteria (proposal): 1) No IP change for typed upgrade path, 2) successful smoke test run, 3) peering config applied and validated, 4) support playbook acknowledged by customer.

claire: Risk: some clouds don't allow external IP reuse in all circumstances. We should call out per-cloud limitations and mark them in the quickstart.

priya: Also add retention defaults for audit logs (30d) and a note on how to configure longer retention to meet enterprise ops.

tom: Owners & near-term tasks:
- Peering quickstart + IAM templates: @priya + @lina
- Offline signed installer & manifest: @devon
- IP-preservation test harness + validation script: @mike
- Support playbook + customer runbook: @sara
- Quickstart one-pager + known-cloud caveats: @claire

ops-bot: Created RDW-PL-4890 "Minimal private deploy networking ship gates" 1 tickets created: RDW-PL-4891..4895 for owners above. ETA 10 business days.

sara: I'll draft the runbook and a short email template customers can forward to netops.

devon: I'll start with signing pipeline + example manifest schema. Will drop a draft in /docs/private/installers.

mike: I'll prototype the validation script and post results in this thread.

tom: Great progress. Let's aim to freeze the minimal gate checklist by Fri and have a validation plan demo next Wed. Ping #eng-runtime if you hit infra blockers. :thumbsup:
